snippet.title: Armored Core: Master of Arena Playthrough (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Armored Core Series: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPO56tlewLYRryyxnGYWHOXf2D1PmFxbC
The last Armored Core game released on the PS1. Unlike the original and Project Phantasma, there are no branching paths to take in the story, though Phantasma only had 3 optional missions. I won't be covering EX-Arena mode.
You can import your save from the previous games and I've done so here.

Vulkan rendering is being used along with PGXP and PGXP's perspective correct texturing option.
Nothing particularly notable about the edit here. There are ~40 edits. There are no in-mission edits and I show all of my part purchases.
